hypotheses.label: Tel Megiddo (Pleiades 26356565)
hypotheses.reasoning: Pleiades attaches the names Megiddo and Magidû to Tel Megiddo with certain association; Keil (1872) also identifies Megiddo with Roman Legio (Lejjun), immediately south of the tell (Pleiades 678266).

description: Fortified city commanding the pass from the coastal plain into the Jezreel valley; where Josiah fell (2 Kgs 23:29–30; 2 Chr 35:22).
